reason: Reports proximate composition, starch fractions, total phenolic content and free amino acids of raw faba beans alongside the same targets after four soaking + boiling treatments; no cooking yield was measured.
foods: faba bean (Vicia faba L., var. Gloria), dried organic, dehulled
treatments: Raw Fb (unprocessed baseline); soaking of 100 g washed beans in 250 mL at 25 °C for 12 h in W: tap water, Sb: sodium bicarbonate (1 g per 250 mL), LAB: L. plantarum (0.1 g freeze-dried culture per 250 mL), SL: Sb + LAB; then boiling in approximately 400 mL of vigorously boiling tap water for 16 min (W, LAB) or 8 min (Sb, SL); cooled by rinsing with cold tap water; freeze-dried for chemical analysis
methods_quote: Soaked and washed faba beans were added to approximately 400 mL of vigorously boiling tap water. Beans soaked in water (control) or LAB were boiled for 16 min, whereas those soaked in sodium bicarbonate or the combination of sodium bicarbonate and LAB were boiled for only 8 min.
basis_quote: Moisture content was also performed in freeze-dried samples, and the results were used to correct subsequent analyses and express data on a dry matter basis (DM).
units: Moisture % wm; Ash, Protein, Fat, RS, NRS % DM; TPC GAE mg/g DM; FAAs mg/g DM
replicates: All analyses were conducted in triplicate on freeze-dried samples, except for moisture, which was measured on fresh samples to determine water uptake.
